people.name: Felicjan Sławoj Składkowski
people.nameZh: 費利茨揚·斯瓦沃伊-斯卡德科夫斯基

body.zh-Hant: 斯卡德科夫斯基1885年6月9日生於貢賓（Gąbin）。1904年入華沙大學醫學系，投身爭取波蘭獨立的活動，因此被逐出學校；他轉到雅蓋隆大學完成學業，1911年取得醫師文憑。
body.en: Składkowski was born on 9 June 1885 in Gąbin. In 1904 he began medical studies at Warsaw University and joined the struggle for Polish independence, for which he was expelled; he finished at the Jagiellonian University and obtained his medical diploma in 1911.

citations.quote: urodził się 9 czerwca 1885 roku w Gąbinie
W 1904 r. rozpoczął naukę na wydziale lekarskim Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego.
Włączył się wówczas aktywnie w walkę o niepodległość Polski
Za tę aktywność wyrzucono go ze studiów
Naukę dokończył na Uniwersytecie Jagiellońskim
dyplom lekarski uzyskał w 1911 r.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年他加入畢蘇斯基的步槍手，以軍醫身分在第1、第7與第5步兵團服務。他拒絕向德國宣誓效忠而被拘禁於貝尼亞米努夫（Beniaminów）營，1918年才離開。
body.en: In 1914 he joined Piłsudski's riflemen and served as a military doctor in the 1st, 7th and 5th infantry regiments. He refused to swear loyalty to the Germans and was interned in the Beniaminów camp, which he left only in 1918.

citations.quote: W 1914 r. wstąpił do strzelców Józefa Piłsudskiego.
Jako lekarz wojskowy służył w 1., 7. i 5. pułku piechoty.
Po odmowie złożenia przysięgi na wierność Niemcom
został internowany w obozie w Beniaminowie
który opuścił dopiero w 1918 r.

heading.zh-Hant: 獨立後的軍政職務與華沙政府專員
heading.en: Post-independence posts and Warsaw government commissioner

body.zh-Hant: 波蘭獨立後，他出任波軍衛生勤務首長，之後在巴爾泰爾（Bartel）內閣主管內政部（來源未載日期）。五月政變中他站在畢蘇斯基一邊，經奧爾利奇-德雷熱爾將軍任命為華沙政府專員；5月14日驅散共產黨示威，5月21日巴爾泰爾內閣成立後他仍留任該職。
body.en: After independence he became head of the Polish Army's sanitary service and later headed the Interior Ministry in Bartel's government (undated in the source). In the May Coup he sided with Piłsudski and General Orlicz-Dreszer appointed him government commissioner for Warsaw; on 14 May he broke up a communist demonstration, and after Bartel's government was formed on 21 May he was kept in the post.

citations.quote: Po odzyskaniu niepodległości
został szefem Służby Sanitarnej Wojska Polskiego
potem kierował Ministerstwem Spraw Wewnętrznych w rządzie Bartla
podczas którego stanął po stronie J. Piłsudskiego
został powołany przez gen. Gustawa Orlicz-Dreszera
na stanowisko komisarza rządu dla Warszawy
rozbicie 14 maja komunistycznej demonstracji na placu Bankowym
citations.evidenceNote: IPN 原文「rozbicie 14 maja komunistycznej demonstracji」

citations.quote: 21 maja, po utworzeniu rządu Kazimierza Bartla
o utrzymaniu Składkowskiego na stanowisku komisarza miasta
wydany 14 V 1926 r. rozkaz rozpędzenia komunistycznego wiecu w Warszawie
citations.evidenceNote: 書評確認 1926 年 5 月 14 日；IPN 該段只寫「14 maja」未寫年

heading.zh-Hant: 內政部長、副軍政部長與議員
heading.en: Interior minister, deputy war minister and deputy

body.zh-Hant: 1926年10月2日，斯卡德科夫斯基接任內政部長，此後除一段約五個月的中斷外，任職到1931年6月；其間他在畢蘇斯基的兩屆內閣、巴爾泰爾第四內閣與斯瓦韋克內閣等政府中主管內政部。1931年6月2日他辭去內政部長，同日被任命為第二軍政部副部長，並自康納熱夫斯基將軍手中接任軍隊行政首長。1935年9月8日起他兼任卡利什與圖雷克選區的議員。
body.en: On 2 October 1926 Składkowski took over the Ministry of Internal Affairs and, apart from a break of about five months, held it until June 1931, serving in Piłsudski's two governments, the fourth Bartel cabinet and the Sławek cabinets among others. On 2 June 1931 he resigned as interior minister and the same day was appointed second deputy minister of military affairs, taking over as chief of Army Administration from General Daniel Konarzewski. From 8 September 1935 he also sat as a deputy for the Kalisz and Turek districts.

obowiązki szefa Administracji Armii z rąk generała Daniela Konarzewskiego
Od 8 września 1935 r. generał pełnił
obowiązki posła z okręgów kaliskiego i turkowskiego

body.zh-Hant: 1936年5月15日他成為總理，領導第二共和國任期最長的內閣。1939年9月戰爭爆發後他隨政府撤離華沙，蘇聯入侵後進入羅馬尼亞並被拘禁，9月30日向新總統拉奇凱維奇（Raczkiewicz）辭職獲准。
body.en: On 15 May 1936 he became prime minister and headed the longest-serving cabinet of the Second Republic. After the outbreak of war in September 1939 he left Warsaw with the government, crossed into Romania after the Soviet invasion and was interned; on 30 September 1939 he resigned, and the new president Raczkiewicz accepted it.

citations.quote: Premierem został 15 maja 1936 roku.
Był szefem najdłużej w II RP urzędującego gabinetu.
Po wybuchu wojny we wrześniu 1939 roku
wraz z rządem ewakuował się z Warszawy
Po sowieckiej agresji na Polskę
przedostał się do Rumunii, gdzie został internowany
30 września 1939 roku podał się do dymisji
którą przyjął nowy prezydent Władysław Raczkiewicz

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月他從拘禁中脫逃並抵達土耳其；1941年1月被送往巴勒斯坦的波蘭喀爾巴阡步槍旅後備中心數月。戰後他定居倫敦，1962年8月31日在當地去世。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他為波蘭將軍與政治家，生卒年1885至1962年。
body.en: In June 1940 he escaped internment and reached Turkey; in January 1941 he was sent for several months to the reserve centre of the Independent Carpathian Rifle Brigade in Palestine. After the war he settled in London, where he died on 31 August 1962. The German National Library authority record calls him a Polish general and politician, 1885–1962.

citations.quote: W czerwcu 1940 r. zbiegł z internowania
przedostał do Turcji.
W styczniu 1941 r. na kilka miesięcy trafił do Ośrodka Zapasowego
Samodzielnej Brygady Strzelców Karpackich w Palestynie.
Po wojnie zamieszkał w Londynie, gdzie zmarł 31 sierpnia 1962 roku.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔（GND）記載，Hugo Celmiņš 1877年10月30日生於盧巴納（Lubāna），1941年7月30日卒於莫斯科；記錄稱他是拉脫維亞政治家與總理，隸屬拉脫維亞農民聯盟（Latvijas Zemnieku Savienība）。
body.en: The German National Library authority record (GND) gives Hugo Celmiņš as born on 30 October 1877 in Lubāna and dead on 30 July 1941 in Moscow; it calls him a Latvian politician and prime minister, affiliated with the Latvian Farmers' Union (Latvijas Zemnieku Savienība).

citations.quote: Lubāna
Moskau
lett. Politiker und Ministerpräsident
Latvijas Zemnieku Savienība

heading.en: Birth, studies and entry into politics

body.zh-Hant: Celmiņš 1877年10月30日生於盧巴納教區的納格里尼（Nagliņi）。他自1899年起就讀里加工學院，1903年畢業於農業系；1908年8月起任里加農業中央協會農藝師，1907至1913年擔任《波羅的海農民》雜誌的負責編輯，1913至1914年在伯恩大學進修並撰寫博士論文。1919年6月他自願加入拉脫維亞臨時政府武裝部隊的拉脫維亞旅，同年10月6日由拉脫維亞農民聯盟推舉為人民議會議員，1920年5月起任制憲議會議員，其後連任第一至第四屆議會議員（1922–1934）。
body.en: Celmiņš was born on 30 October 1877 at Nagliņi in Lubāna parish. From 1899 he studied at the Riga Polytechnic Institute and graduated from its agriculture department in 1903. He was an agronomist at the Riga Agricultural Central Society from August 1908 and responsible editor of the journal Baltijas Lauksaimnieks in 1907–1913, and studied at the University of Bern in 1913–1914. In June 1919 he volunteered for the Latvian brigade of the Provisional Government forces; on 6 October 1919 the Latvian Farmers' Union elected him to the People's Council, from May 1920 he sat in the Constituent Assembly, and he then served in all four Saeimas (1922–1934).

heading.en: Minister of Agriculture and of Education

body.zh-Hant: 1920年6月12日至1921年6月18日，Celmiņš在第四屆內閣出任農業部長；1921年6月19日至1923年8月任農業副部長，1923年10月15日至1924年1月26日任教育部長。1924年12月19日他組閣後再度兼任農業部長，至1925年3月5日。
body.en: From 12 June 1920 to 18 June 1921 Celmiņš was Minister of Agriculture in the Fourth Cabinet; he was deputy agriculture minister from 19 June 1921 to August 1923 and Minister of Education from 15 October 1923 to 26 January 1924. After forming his government on 19 December 1924 he again held the agriculture portfolio until 5 March 1925.

heading.zh-Hant: 兩屆內閣總理與外交部長
heading.en: Two governments as prime minister and foreign minister

body.zh-Hant: 1924年12月19日Celmiņš出任總理，內閣至1925年12月23日；外交部長梅羅維奇斯1925年8月22日去世後，他自8月23日起兼任外交部長至12月23日。1928年12月1日他再度出任總理，內閣至1931年3月26日，共27個月又26天；1930年2月5日起他又兼任外交部長，同年9月率拉脫維亞代表團出席國際聯盟第11屆大會。
body.en: Celmiņš became prime minister on 19 December 1924 and his government lasted until 23 December 1925; after foreign minister Meierovics died on 22 August 1925 he also took the foreign affairs portfolio from 23 August to 23 December. He again became prime minister on 1 December 1928, his government lasting until 26 March 1931 (27 months and 26 days); from 5 February 1930 he was also foreign minister, and in September 1930 he led the Latvian delegation to the 11th Assembly of the League of Nations.

heading.en: Mayor of Riga, envoy and death

body.zh-Hant: Celmiņš 1931年5月5日至1935年9月1日任里加市長，1935年10月1日起任駐德國、奧地利與荷蘭的特命全權公使，駐柏林，在德國的任期到1938年8月。1940年10月11日他在家中被捕，1941年7月7日在莫斯科列福爾托沃監獄被判處槍決，7月30日在莫斯科的科穆納爾卡射擊場死去。
body.en: Celmiņš was mayor of Riga from 5 May 1931 to 1 September 1935, then from 1 October 1935 extraordinary envoy and minister plenipotentiary to Germany, Austria and the Netherlands, seated in Berlin, with his German posting running to August 1938. He was arrested at home on 11 October 1940, sentenced to death in Moscow's Lefortovo prison on 7 July 1941, and died on 30 July 1941 at the Komunarka firing ground near Moscow.

people.name: Dansranbilegiin Dogsom
people.nameZh: 丹斯蘭畢勒格音·道克索姆

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔（GND）的說明稱，丹斯蘭畢勒格音·道克索姆1884年生於今肯特省（Khentii）巴彥奧沃（Bayan-Ovoo）縣，是蒙古的重要革命領導人，也是革命後蒙古人民共和國的政治人物。
body.en: The German National Library authority record (GND) says Dansranbilegiin Dogsom was born in 1884 in what is now the Bayan-Ovoo district of Khentii Province, a prominent Mongolian revolutionary leader and a political figure of the post-revolution Mongolian People's Republic.

citations.quote: was born in 1884 in present day Bayan-Ovoo district of Khentii Province
prominent Mongolian revolutionary leader
post-Revolution political figure in Mongolian People's Republic

heading.en: The officials' faction and the early revolution

body.zh-Hant: 據阿特伍德編的《蒙古與蒙古帝國百科全書》，達恩津、丁杜布與道克索姆（D. Dogsom，1884–1941）創立「官員派」（又稱東庫倫集團），成員是神權政府的低階官員，不少人在議會下院任職。人民黨取得波格達汗蓋章的求援書後，七名代表前往伊爾庫茨克求助，達恩津、道克索姆與蘇赫巴托爾來自「官員派」；道克索姆與博多隨後回到庫倫籌組黨。
body.en: According to Atwood's Encyclopedia of Mongolia and the Mongol Empire, Danzin, Dindub and Dogsom (D. Dogsom, 1884–1941) founded the "officials' faction" (also the East Khüriye Group), made up of lower-level officials in the theocratic government, many of them in the lower house of parliament. After the People's Party obtained a stamped appeal from the Bogda Khan, seven delegates went to Irkutsk to ask for help, with Danzin, Dogsom and Sükhebaatur coming from the officials' faction; Dogsom and Bodô then returned to Khüriye to organize the party.

heading.zh-Hant: 國家小呼拉爾主席團主席與去世

body.zh-Hant: GND 說明稱，他自1936年起擔任蒙古人民共和國國家小呼拉爾主席團主席（名義上的國家元首），1939年遭整肅；說明記他卒於1941年7月27日，權威檔記卒地為莫斯科。
body.en: The GND note says he served from 1936 as Chairman of the Presidium of the State Little Khural of the Mongolian People's Republic (titular head of state) until he was purged in 1939; it gives his death as 27 July 1941, and the authority record places it in Moscow.

citations.quote: Chairman of the Presidium of the State Little Khural
from 1936 until he was purged in 1939
Moskau

body.zh-Hant: 據阿特伍德書，1936年艾馬爾（Anandyn Amar）與道克索姆曾設法釋放仍被關押在所謂「倫貝案」中的受害者。該書大清洗條目記載，1921年革命者中僅存的洛索爾與道克索姆被逮捕、押往蘇聯並遭處決。巴特賽罕在斯普林格出版的專書圖說也稱，他是蒙古人民革命黨創黨成員之一，1936年起任國家小呼拉爾主席團主席，1939年遭整肅。
body.en: According to Atwood, in 1936 Amar and Dogsom tried to free victims still held in the bogus Lhümbe case. The book's Great Purge entry records that Losol and Dogsom, the last surviving revolutionaries of 1921, were arrested, deported to the Soviet Union and executed. A figure caption in Batsaikhan's Springer volume likewise calls him one of the founding members of the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party, chairman of the Presidium of the State Little Khural from 1936 until he was purged in 1939.
